Payout of 22 July is short ₹3,915.42.
The bank credited ₹1,58,081.70 against an expected ₹1,61,997.12. 19 orders sit in this payout. 3 different combinations of ledger entries add up to this difference and nothing in the records tells them apart, so no single explanation can be given.
Suggested action: ask the gateway which entries it deducted from this payout, since the amounts alone cannot separate them.
